---
Return the equivalent of the HTTP request's SCRIPT\_NAME environment
variable. If Apache mod\_rewrite is used, return what would have been
the script name prior to any rewriting (so it's the script name as seen
from the client's perspective), unless the FORCE\_SCRIPT\_NAME setting is
set (to anything).

# django/dispatch/dispatcher.py:152  (django.dispatch.dispatcher.Signal.send)
```python

    self: Self@Signal,
    sender: Unknown,
    **named: Unknown
) -> (list[Unknown] | list[tuple[Unknown, Unknown]])
```
---
Send signal from sender to all connected receivers.

If any receiver raises an error, the error propagates back through send,
terminating the dispatch loop. So it's possible that all receivers
won't be called if an error is raised.

Arguments:

    sender  
        The sender of the signal. Either a specific object or None.

    named  
        Named arguments which will be passed to receivers.

Return a list of tuple pairs \[(receiver, response), ... \].
